title: Arista Networks Q1 2026 financial results
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was USD 2.709 billion, up 35.1% year over year; GAAP operating margin was 42.7%, operating cash flow was USD 1.6935 billion, and Q2 revenue guidance was approximately USD 2.8 billion.
summary: Arista reported strong Q1 growth, margins and cash generation, supported by AI and cloud networking demand, while guiding to approximately USD 2.8 billion of Q2 revenue.
